text:
Oncall Bot: :rotating_light: Incident alert: decode tail latency spike detected across us-west-2 + eu-central-1. p95 jumped from 120ms -> 780ms, p99 ~ 2.1s. Streaming stalls reported. Paging events increased on allocator nodes. Rolling kernel rollout at 2319876400 suspected.
Alex: I'm on it. Observed increased page faults on decode kernel after TRT/FlashAttention 8.2.1 rollout. Correlates with deploys at 2319876389.
Sophie: Linking the perf dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/rt-decode?range=15m
Jamal: We saw a spike in kv-cache misses too.
Maya: Any customer-facing impact? Should we page support?
Kevin: A few 500s on streaming endpoints reported by alpha-corp. They hit retries and timeouts.
Alex: repro: run a local decode with same model/seq and flags shows tail hangs. Command used:
```
run_decode --model gpt-redwood-v1 --seq 2048 --trt-optim flashattn --compiler-flag O3
```
Sophie: Can we test disabling flashattn runtime path on a canary host?
Alex: I'm building a hotpatch to toggle `--trt-optim=none` and fallback kernel.
InfraOps: Scaling more decode pods by +20% to absorb backlog: `k scale deploy/decode --replicas=12 -n prod-usw2`
Jamal: Suggest rolling back the compiler flag change from earlier patch (added `-mavx512f` for newer kernels). That flag may be triggering different code paths.
Maya: For customer comms: support, please prepare message: brief, impacted endpoints, mitigation in progress, ETA ~ 30m.
Sophie: Traces show long compilepath times in JIT stage during first token. Attaching snippet:
```
[compile] path: /opt/runtime/compilepath.cc: allocate_pages -> 47ms
[decode] kv-cache init -> 980ms
```
Alex: Pushing hotpatch now to one rack: `ansible-playbook hotpatch_decode.yml -e env=prod-usw2 -l rack-7`
Kevin: If hotpatch clears, we can canary wider. If not, plan B: rollback TRT build to 8.1.4.
Oncall Bot: Handoff reminder: next on-call @Jamal in 15m. Use incident-runbook #decode-paging.
Jamal: I have the handoff. I'll monitor logs, coordinate rollback if hotpatch fails. @Sophie please keep perf dashboard open.
Sophie: Hotpatch succeeded on rack-7 — p95 fell from 780ms -> 140ms within 90s. Marking as mitigation succeeded on canary.
Alex: Expanding hotpatch to remaining racks in us-west-2. Rolling back TRT build on eu-central-1 as preemptive measure.
InfraOps: eu-central-1 rollback in progress: `deploy-revert --artifact trt-8.2.1 --target eu-central-1`
Maya: Support update drafted: "Mitigation applied; customers may experience degraded streaming for up to 10 more minutes. We're monitoring." :thumbsup: 
Kevin: After expansion, we should run a replayed load test to validate p99 stability.
Jamal: Agreed. Schedule immediate 5-min smoke with synthetic traces.
Oncall Bot: Incident severity reduced to SEV-2. Continue monitoring; update incident board.
Alex: Follow-up actions: 1) Re-run kernel regression test, 2) Add perf unit to CI for new compiler flags, 3) Postmortem draft assigned to Alex/Sophie/Jamal.
Maya: I'll coordinate customer follow-ups and escalation notes.
Sophie: Noted. Closing active paging loop; keep this thread for postmortem notes.
Jamal: Handoff complete. I'm available for the next hour.
